objectives.whereEn: Phase 1 is just Reno, phase 2 Rude joins. Focus on Rude first (weak to Wind), don't use Ifrit on Rude. After winning, run around the pillar to Tifa.

chapters.title: A Broken World
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Setelah turun ke Underground Test Site sebagai Barret, kamu nggak bisa balik ke atas sampai bab selesai. Ambil semua peti dan beli disc di vending machine lab sebelum lawan Failed Experiment.

objectives.name: Through the Rubble
objectives.where: Nyusup lewat celah puing ke Tifa, lalu dorong dinding buat ketemu Barret.
objectives.whereEn: Sneak through the gap in the rubble to Tifa, then push the wall to meet Barret.

objectives.name: Gift of Hope
objectives.where: Jalan lewat Wall Market ke Sector 5 Slums, menuju rumah Aerith bareng Barret.
objectives.whereEn: Walk through Wall Market to the Sector 5 Slums, heading to Aerith's house with Barret.

objectives.name: Mythical Amulet
objectives.where: Aerith's House - 2F: chest di kamar tempat Marlene istirahat (Checking on Friends); ambil sebelum berangkat ke Sector 7.
objectives.whereEn: Aerith's House - 2F: chest in the room where Marlene rests (Checking on Friends); grab it before leaving for Sector 7.

objectives.name: Checking on Friends / Onward to Sector 7 / To the Underground Passage
objectives.where: Balik arah ke Sector 7 lewat Collapsed Expressway. Ringmaw & Varghidpolis lemah Ice.
objectives.whereEn: Head back to Sector 7 via the Collapsed Expressway. Ringmaw & Varghidpolis are weak to Ice.

objectives.name: Heavy-Duty Bracer
objectives.where: Bandits' Den: setelah turun tangga, lorong samping dari area terbuka tempat Smogger & Sweeper Prototype. Opsional: curian Rude (Ch12) & dijual di Sector 5/6. (Area peti menurut data peti game.)
objectives.whereEn: Bandits' Den: after going down the stairs, take the side corridor off the open area with the Smogger & Sweeper Prototype. Optional: Rude's steal (Ch12) & sold in Sector 5/6. (Chest area per the game's chest data.)

objectives.name: Beck's Badasses
objectives.where: Ada Smogger & Sweeper Prototype, lalu dua grup bandit dan trio Beck. Ether ada di jalan kanan pas grup bandit kedua.
objectives.whereEn: There is a Smogger & Sweeper Prototype, then two bandit groups and Beck's trio. The Ether is on the right path at the second bandit group.

objectives.name: Big Bertha (Barret)
objectives.where: Evergreen Park: beli di vendor senjata di perkemahan pengungsi Sector 7 (taman bermain), 2.500 gil.
objectives.whereEn: Evergreen Park: buy it from the weapon vendor in the Sector 7 refugee camp (playground), 2,500 gil.

objectives.name: Music Disc: On Our Way
objectives.where: Evergreen Park: item shop di perkemahan baru setelah terowongan, 50 gil.
objectives.whereEn: Evergreen Park: item shop in the new camp after the tunnel, 50 gil.

objectives.name: Crawling to the Surface / Home Is Where the Heart Is
objectives.where: Ikuti terowongan dan tangga, dorong penghalang bareng Barret lalu ikuti kucing.
objectives.whereEn: Follow the tunnel and stairs, push the barrier with Barret, then follow the cat.

objectives.name: In Solitude
objectives.where: Tembak batu/derek/kipas buat buka jalan. Pecahkan semua Shinra box, kadang isinya Moogle Medal.
objectives.whereEn: Shoot the rocks/cranes/fans to open the way. Break all the Shinra boxes; sometimes they contain a Moogle Medal.

objectives.name: Healing Carcanet
objectives.where: Underground Test Site (B4, In Solitude): di lorong berikutnya, belok utara dulu dan hancurkan dinding/puing; chest di baliknya.
objectives.whereEn: Underground Test Site (B4, In Solitude): in the next corridor, turn north first and destroy the wall/rubble; the chest is behind it.

objectives.name: Reunite with Tifa
objectives.where: Naik tangga, tembak derek untuk bakar serangga, lalu bantu Tifa lawan kawanan bug.
objectives.whereEn: Go up the stairs, shoot the crane to burn the insects, then help Tifa fight the swarm of bugs.

objectives.name: Ice Materia
objectives.where: Underground Test Site (B2, Finding Wedge): kandang kanan, tembak gerbangnya. Opsional: dijual di toko materia.
objectives.whereEn: Underground Test Site (B2, Finding Wedge): right cage, shoot the gate. Optional: sold at the materia shop.

objectives.name: Warding Materia
objectives.where: Underground Test Site (B2, Finding Wedge): naik tangga ke kandang di balik pintu, tembak gerbangnya.
objectives.whereEn: Underground Test Site (B2, Finding Wedge): go up the stairs to the cage behind the door, shoot the gate.

objectives.name: Music Disc: Main Theme of FFVII
objectives.where: Break Room: vending machine di samping bench di B1 Underground Test Site, langsung di jalur cerita setelah lawan kawanan serangga. 50 gil.
objectives.whereEn: Break Room: vending machine next to the bench on B1 of the Underground Test Site, right on the story path after fighting the insect swarm. 50 gil.

objectives.name: Finding Wedge
objectives.where: Lemah Ice, pasang Elemental+Ice di senjata. Sembunyi di balik kontainer pas Plasma Discharge. Bisa Steal materia Poison. Mythril Claws (Tifa) didapat sekitar bos ini. Boss: Failed Experiment.
objectives.whereEn: Weak to Ice; equip Elemental+Ice on a weapon. Hide behind the containers during Plasma Discharge. You can Steal Poison materia. Mythril Claws (Tifa) are obtained around this boss. Boss: Failed Experiment.

objectives.name: Poison Materia (curi)
objectives.where: Underground Test Site: curi dari boss Failed Experiment pakai Steal Materia.
objectives.whereEn: Underground Test Site: steal from the Failed Experiment boss with Steal Materia.

objectives.name: Mythril Claws (Tifa)
objectives.where: Underground Test Site (B1, Finding Wedge): otomatis didapat setelah mengalahkan Failed Experiment.
objectives.whereEn: Underground Test Site (B1, Finding Wedge): obtained automatically after defeating the Failed Experiment.

objectives.name: Beyond the Fracture / Return
objectives.where: Tembak dinding, intip lubang, lalu gendong Wedge keluar sebagai Barret.
objectives.whereEn: Shoot the wall, peek through the hole, then carry Wedge out as Barret.

chapters.title: In Search of Hope
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Manjat tembok pakai Grappling Gun bareng Leslie (Over the Wall) mengunci semua Odd Jobs, Colosseum, toko Wall Market dan hub Sector 5/6. Selesaikan 9 side quest + Johnny's Stolen Wallet, Colosseum, disc, Chadley/Bahamut, dan Letter from the Guardian Angel dulu.

objectives.name: Resolve
objectives.where: Cloud bangun malam; siapa yang diajak ngobrol tergantung pilihanmu sebelumnya.
objectives.whereEn: Cloud wakes up at night; who you talk to depends on your earlier choices.

objectives.name: Pedometer Materia
objectives.where: Aerith's House: tergeletak di tanah tepat di depan rumah saat keluar, di kaki tangga yang turun ke arah Center District. Bawa terus; setelah sekitar 5.000 langkah berubah jadi AP Up.
objectives.whereEn: Aerith's House: lying on the ground right in front of the house when you exit, at the foot of the stairs leading down toward the Center District. Keep carrying it; after about 5,000 steps it turns into AP Up.

objectives.name: Intel Gathering
objectives.where: Ke Center District Sector 5, cutscene Tifa lalu Kyrie. Semua side quest Ch14 dibuka di sini.
objectives.whereEn: Go to the Center District in Sector 5, Tifa cutscene then Kyrie. All Ch14 side quests are unlocked here.

objectives.name: Chadley: Battle Intel & VR Bahamut
objectives.where: Center District: Chadley berdiri di tempat yang sama seperti Ch8. Setor Battle Intel yang tersisa (#16 Enemy Skill, #17 Skill Master, #18 MP Absorption, #19 HP Absorption), lalu VR Bahamut (#20) terbuka. Masih bisa disetor ke Chadley di Ch16 (Combat Simulator Lounge).
objectives.whereEn: Center District: Chadley stands in the same place as in Ch8. Turn in the remaining Battle Intel (#16 Enemy Skill, #17 Skill Master, #18 MP Absorption, #19 HP Absorption), then VR Bahamut (#20) unlocks. You can still turn them in to Chadley in Ch16 (Combat Simulator Lounge).

objectives.name: Moogle Emporium (Children's Secret Hideout)
objectives.where: Children's Secret Hideout: tukar Moogle Medal ke Moggie. Stok Ch14: Steel Pincers (7), Silver Staff (2), Enfeeblement Ring (1), Whistlewind Scarf (3), Salvation Badge (1), manuskrip Vol. I tiap karakter (5), Moogle's Mortar (1) untuk Secret Medicine.
objectives.whereEn: Children's Secret Hideout: trade Moogle Medals to Moggie. Ch14 stock: Steel Pincers (7), Silver Staff (2), Enfeeblement Ring (1), Whistlewind Scarf (3), Salvation Badge (1), Vol. I manuscript for each character (5), Moogle's Mortar (1) for Secret Medicine.

objectives.name: Whack-a-Box (Hard): Transference Module
objectives.where: Children's Secret Hideout: main Whack-a-Box tingkat Hard (terbuka di Ch14). 30.000 poin = Transference Module; semua target Hard = trofi Whack-a-Box Wunderkind.
objectives.whereEn: Children's Secret Hideout: play Whack-a-Box on Hard (unlocked in Ch14). 30,000 points = Transference Module; all Hard targets = Whack-a-Box Wunderkind trophy.

objectives.name: Music Disc: Descendant of Shinobi
objectives.where: Sector 5 Undercity Station: bicara dengan pria di dekat Johnny di stasiun. Juga bisa didapat di tempat yang sama pada Ch8.
objectives.whereEn: Sector 5 Undercity Station: talk to the man near Johnny in the station. Also obtainable in the same place in Ch8.

objectives.name: Mythril Armlet
objectives.where: Station Way: peti di jalan utara Station Way (selatan titik disc Descendant of Shinobi, dekat pria bersenjata). Juga dijual di toko senjata Wall Market (3.200 gil). Peti yang sama dengan Ch8 (treasure0160): kalau sudah dibuka di Ch8, peti ini kosong; beli di toko.
objectives.whereEn: Station Way: chest on the north road of Station Way (south of the Descendant of Shinobi disc spot, near the armed man). Also sold at the Wall Market weapon shop (3,200 gil). Same chest as in Ch8 (treasure0160): if you opened it in Ch8 it is empty; buy one instead.

objectives.name: Tomboy Bandit
objectives.where: Sector 5 Undercity Station: Johnny memberi quest. Temui Kyrie di Church, pilih Special Match di Colosseum Wall Market (Beastmaster + Hellhound), lalu kembali ke Kyrie di Church. Hadiah: Corneo Vault Key + Johnny's Wallet (Hard: Art of Swordplay Vol. XI).
objectives.whereEn: Sector 5 Undercity Station: Johnny gives the quest. Meet Kyrie at the Church, pick Special Match at the Wall Market Colosseum (Beastmaster + Hellhound), then return to Kyrie at the Church. Reward: Corneo Vault Key + Johnny's Wallet (Hard: Art of Swordplay Vol. XI).

objectives.name: Chocobo Search
objectives.where: Station Way: quest dari stablehand. Chocobo 1 di ujung utara Nuts 'n' Bolts Hills (kalahkan Rust Drake), chocobo 2 di Sanctuary Way, jalan dari stasiun ke arah gereja (tanpa musuh), chocobo 3 di Collapsed Expressway - Old Bypass (kalahkan 3 Trypapolis). Lapor ke Sam di Wall Market. Hadiah: Sam's Delivery Lifetime Pass. Hard: Rust Drake (Nuts 'n' Bolts Hills) = Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. XI, Trypapolis (Collapsed Expressway - Old Bypass) = Way of the Fist Vol. XI.
objectives.whereEn: Station Way: quest from the stablehand. Chocobo 1 at the north end of Nuts 'n' Bolts Hills (defeat the Rust Drake), chocobo 2 on Sanctuary Way, the road from the station toward the church (no enemies), chocobo 3 at Collapsed Expressway - Old Bypass (defeat 3 Trypapolis). Report to Sam in Wall Market. Reward: Sam's Delivery Lifetime Pass. Hard: Rust Drake (Nuts 'n' Bolts Hills) = Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. XI, Trypapolis (Collapsed Expressway - Old Bypass) = Way of the Fist Vol. XI.

objectives.name: Enemy Skill: Self-Destruct
objectives.where: Steel Mountain: biarkan Smogger (timur laut Sector 5) memakai Self-Destruct ke pemegang Enemy Skill materia. Alternatif: Proto-Trypapolis (Chocobo Search) atau H0512-OPT di Ch16.
objectives.whereEn: Steel Mountain: let the Smogger (northeast Sector 5) use Self-Destruct on the character holding the Enemy Skill materia. Alternatives: Proto-Trypapolis (Chocobo Search) or H0512-OPT in Ch16.

objectives.name: Missing Children
objectives.where: Center District: quest dari Ms. Folia. Pergi ke Slum Public Cemetery (timur laut Sector 5), kalahkan 2 Phantom (lemah Fire) untuk menyelamatkan Oates. Hadiah: Time Materia (Hard: Way of the Fist Vol. X).
objectives.whereEn: Center District: quest from Ms. Folia. Go to the Slum Public Cemetery (northeast Sector 5), defeat 2 Phantoms (weak to Fire) to rescue Oates. Reward: Time Materia (Hard: Way of the Fist Vol. X).

objectives.name: Time Materia
objectives.where: Slum Public Cemetery: hadiah otomatis setelah menyelesaikan Missing Children.
objectives.whereEn: Slum Public Cemetery: automatic reward after completing Missing Children.

objectives.name: Enemy Skill: Spirit Siphon
objectives.where: Slum Public Cemetery: saat Missing Children, biarkan Phantom memakai Essence Drain ke karakter yang memasang Enemy Skill materia. Untuk trofi Master of Mimicry.
objectives.whereEn: Slum Public Cemetery: during Missing Children, let a Phantom use Essence Drain on the character with Enemy Skill materia equipped. For the Master of Mimicry trophy.

objectives.name: Secret Medicine
objectives.where: Center District: quest dari dokter. Moogle's Mortar dari Moggie di Children's Secret Hideout (1 medal), Medicinal Flowers di lantai dalam Church (barat laut Sector 5), Behemoth Horn dari Subterranean Menace. Hadiah: Telluric Scriptures Vol. III.
objectives.whereEn: Center District: quest from the doctor. Moogle's Mortar from Moggie in the Children's Secret Hideout (1 medal), Medicinal Flowers on the inner floor of the Church (northwest Sector 5), Behemoth Horn from Subterranean Menace. Reward: Telluric Scriptures Vol. III.

objectives.name: Corneo's Secret Stash
objectives.where: Sanctuary Way: quest dari reporter Damon (pindah ke depan Church kalau Tomboy Bandit sudah diambil). Gerbang naga merah-emas: Steel Mountain dekat pos chocobo (Ruby Tiara), Collapsed Expressway cabang kiri di terowongan (Diamond Tiara), dan sewer Ch14 (Emerald Tiara). Serahkan tiara ke Marle. Hadiah: Art of Swordplay Vol. III. Isi tambahan: di balik gerbang naga Steel Mountain juga ada Moogle Medal, Prayer Materia dan Circlet; stash Collapsed Expressway berisi Moogle Medal; stash sewer berisi Enfeeblement Ring.
objectives.whereEn: Sanctuary Way: quest from the reporter Damon (he moves in front of the Church if Tomboy Bandit has been taken). Red-and-gold dragon gates: Steel Mountain near the chocobo post (Ruby Tiara), Collapsed Expressway left branch in the tunnel (Diamond Tiara), and the Ch14 sewer (Emerald Tiara). Hand the tiaras to Marle. Reward: Art of Swordplay Vol. III. Extra contents: behind the Steel Mountain dragon gate there is also a Moogle Medal, Prayer Materia and Circlet; the Collapsed Expressway stash contains a Moogle Medal; the sewer stash contains an Enfeeblement Ring.

objectives.name: Music Disc: Turks' Theme
objectives.where: S6-5 Road: bicara dengan nenek yang berdiri di tepi air dekat reruntuhan, di jalan melingkar tengah antara Sector 5 dan 6.
objectives.whereEn: S6-5 Road: talk to the old woman standing at the water's edge near the ruins, on the middle loop road between Sector 5 and 6.

objectives.name: Subterranean Menace
objectives.where: Evergreen Park: quest dari Wymer. Pintu masuk lab ada di samping Wymer di bawah kubah putih; turun sampai Underground Lab B5, pintu setengah terbuka berpita kuning. Boss Type-0 Behemoth (hancurkan tanduk dulu, hindari Comet). Hadiah: Wrecking Ball + Behemoth Horn (Hard: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. X).
objectives.whereEn: Evergreen Park: quest from Wymer. The lab entrance is next to Wymer under the white dome; go down to Underground Lab B5, the half-open door with yellow tape. Boss Type-0 Behemoth (destroy the horn first, avoid Comet). Reward: Wrecking Ball + Behemoth Horn (Hard: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. X).

objectives.name: Wrecking Ball (Barret)
objectives.where: Evergreen Park: diberikan Wymer setelah Subterranean Menace selesai.
objectives.whereEn: Evergreen Park: given by Wymer after Subterranean Menace is complete.

objectives.name: To Wall Market
objectives.where: Jalan kaki atau naik Chocobo Carriage (300 gil).
objectives.whereEn: Walk or take the Chocobo Carriage (300 gil).

objectives.name: Sorcerer's Armlet (chest)
objectives.where: Wall Market: masuk gang sempit (harus menyelip) di dekat pintu Honeybee Inn, peti di ujung gang. Juga dijual di toko senjata.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: enter a narrow alley (you must squeeze through) near the Honeybee Inn door, chest at the end of the alley. Also sold at the weapon shop.

objectives.name: Moogle Medal (chest)
objectives.where: Wall Market: dari gerbang masuk belok ke utara ke gang buntu; peti di ujung utara gang.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: from the entrance gate turn north into the dead-end alley; chest at the north end of the alley.

objectives.name: Mythril Saber (Cloud)
objectives.where: Wall Market: beli di toko senjata (3.000 gil). Juga dijual di toko Combat Simulator Lounge Ch16.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: buy at the weapon shop (3,000 gil). Also sold at the Ch16 Combat Simulator Lounge shop.

objectives.name: Music Disc: Stand Up
objectives.where: Wall Market: bicara dengan gadis di gang belakang, sebelah kiri pintu masuk Honeybee Inn.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: talk to the girl in the back alley, left of the Honeybee Inn entrance.

objectives.name: Music Disc: Good Night, Until Tomorrow
objectives.where: Wall Market: masuk hotel/inn, belok kanan, bicara dengan kakek beruban di seberang resepsionis.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: enter the hotel/inn, turn right, talk to the gray-haired old man across from the reception desk.

objectives.name: Music Disc: Wutai
objectives.where: Urban Advancement District: di jalan samping arah barat di selatan Colosseum, kira-kira di tengah distrik; bicara dengan pria yang mendengarkan gramofon.
objectives.whereEn: Urban Advancement District: on the side road heading west south of the Colosseum, roughly in the middle of the district; talk to the man listening to the gramophone.

objectives.name: Music Disc: Fight On!
objectives.where: Wall Market: beli di Souvenir Shop di aula masuk Colosseum, 50 gil.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: buy at the Souvenir Shop in the Colosseum entrance hall, 50 gil.

objectives.name: The Power of Music
objectives.where: Wall Market: quest dari Betty. Kumpulkan Good Night, Until Tomorrow, Fight On! dan Stand Up, lalu putar di jukebox dekat Betty. Hadiah: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. III.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: quest from Betty. Collect Good Night, Until Tomorrow, Fight On! and Stand Up, then play them at the jukebox near Betty. Reward: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. III.

objectives.name: Wavering Heart
objectives.where: Wall Market: di gym, kalahkan Andrea dalam lomba pull-up (Tifa, tombol acak makin cepat). Hadiah: Way of the Fist Vol. III.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: at the gym, beat Andrea in the pull-up contest (Tifa, random buttons that get faster). Reward: Way of the Fist Vol. III.

objectives.name: Pull-Up Challenge: Magic Up & Champion Belt
objectives.where: Wall Market: di gym setelah Wavering Heart, menang Pull-Up Challenge Amateur (Jay) = Magic Up Materia, Pro (Jules) = Champion Belt + trofi Peeress of Pull-Ups.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: at the gym after Wavering Heart, win the Pull-Up Challenge Amateur (Jay) = Magic Up Materia, Pro (Jules) = Champion Belt + Peeress of Pull-Ups trophy.

objectives.name: Peeress of Pull-Ups
objectives.where: Menangkan Pull-Up Challenge tingkat Pro (Jules) di gym Wall Market, setelah Wavering Heart.
objectives.whereEn: Win the Pro-level Pull-Up Challenge (Jules) at the Wall Market gym, after Wavering Heart.

objectives.name: Malicious Goons
objectives.where: Aerith's House: quest dari Madam M di Wall Market; pertarungan di arena bundar dekat rumah Aerith (tempat lawan Reno). Kalahkan Tonberry, jaga jarak dari pisaunya. Hadiah: Elixir (Hard: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. IX).
objectives.whereEn: Aerith's House: quest from Madam M in Wall Market; the fight is in the round arena near Aerith's house (where you fought Reno). Defeat the Tonberry, keep your distance from its knife. Reward: Elixir (Hard: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. IX).

objectives.name: Corneo Colosseum: Battle Challenges
objectives.where: Wall Market: daftar di Colosseum. Barret/Tifa vs Wild Animals = Legacy: Catastrophe / Legacy: Dolphin Flurry; Barret/Tifa/Cloud vs Shinra Thugs = manuskrip Vol. II; 2 orang vs Slum Outlaws = Clarity Pendant; 3 orang vs Shinra Warriors = Tarot Cards; 3 orang vs Team Payback = Moogle's Amulet.
objectives.whereEn: Wall Market: sign up at the Colosseum. Barret/Tifa vs Wild Animals = Legacy: Catastrophe / Legacy: Dolphin Flurry; Barret/Tifa/Cloud vs Shinra Thugs = Vol. II manuscript; 2 members vs Slum Outlaws = Clarity Pendant; 3 members vs Shinra Warriors = Tarot Cards; 3 members vs Team Payback = Moogle's Amulet.

objectives.name: Discovery: Johnny's Stolen Wallet
objectives.where: Sector 5 Undercity Station: setelah Tomboy Bandit, kembalikan dompet ke Johnny (penanda Discovery ungu). Untuk trofi The Johnny Experience.
objectives.whereEn: Sector 5 Undercity Station: after Tomboy Bandit, return the wallet to Johnny (purple Discovery marker). For The Johnny Experience trophy.

objectives.name: Corneo's Mansion
objectives.where: Naik ke lantai atas lewat pintu ganda, cutscene Leslie.
objectives.whereEn: Go upstairs through the double doors, Leslie cutscene.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: beresin semua side quest, Colosseum, Moogle Emporium, Chadley. Setelah ikut Leslie ke saluran bawah tanah, slum & Wall Market tertutup.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: finish all side quests, the Colosseum, Moogle Emporium and Chadley. After following Leslie into the underground channel, the slums & Wall Market are closed off.

objectives.name: Otherworldly Crystal (chest)
objectives.where: Underground Passage: di Corneo's Mansion naik ke lantai atas, masuk pintu ketiga, turun tangga ke lorong bawah tanah; peti di dasar tangga.
objectives.whereEn: Underground Passage: in Corneo's Mansion go upstairs, enter the third door, go down the stairs to the underground corridor; chest at the bottom of the stairs.

objectives.name: Chakra Materia
objectives.where: Forbidden Room: dari Corneo's Office lewat pintu samping turun ke ruang bawah, lepaskan Kotch dari meja; dia meninggalkan Chakra Materia.
objectives.whereEn: Forbidden Room: from Corneo's Office go through the side door down to the lower room, free Kotch from the table; he leaves behind Chakra Materia.

objectives.name: Through the Underground Waterway
objectives.where: Ikuti Leslie ke sewer. Ether ada di peti setelah tangga pendek, sebelum terowongan melingkar.
objectives.whereEn: Follow Leslie into the sewer. The Ether is in a chest after a short staircase, before the circular tunnel.

objectives.name: The Hideout
objectives.where: Habisi 3 Scissorclaws di pintu berlentera, lalu ketemu Leslie.
objectives.whereEn: Take out 3 Scissorclaws at the lantern door, then meet Leslie.

objectives.name: Recovering the Key
objectives.where: Sector 6 Restricted Area & Old Line. Peti: Hazardous Material x2 (kanan), Phoenix Down x2 (seberang jembatan), Mega-Potion x2, Ether (pojok kiri).
objectives.whereEn: Sector 6 Restricted Area & Old Line. Chests: Hazardous Material x2 (right), Phoenix Down x2 (across the bridge), Mega-Potion x2, Ether (left corner).

objectives.name: Poison Materia
objectives.where: Old Aqueduct 1: tergeletak di pojok barat daya ruangan tempat melawan Blugu + Abzu Shoat (jalur Old Line), terlihat jelas.
objectives.whereEn: Old Aqueduct 1: lying in the southwest corner of the room where you fight Blugu + Abzu Shoat (Old Line route), clearly visible.

objectives.name: Fateful Decisions
objectives.where: Kalahkan Mischievous Shoat + 3 Abzu Shoat, ambil kuncinya.
objectives.whereEn: Defeat the Mischievous Shoat + 3 Abzu Shoat, take the key.

objectives.name: Protective Boots
objectives.where: Former Disposal Area: peti di ujung koridor kiri, di pojok sebelum kembali ke terowongan utama.
objectives.whereEn: Former Disposal Area: chest at the end of the left corridor, in the corner before returning to the main tunnel.

objectives.name: Corneo's Secret Stash: stash sewer
objectives.where: Former Disposal Area: setelah Mischievous Shoat kalah, jangan langsung naik tangga; pakai konsol di kanan untuk menguras air, lalu buka gerbang naga dengan Vault Key. Isi: Emerald Tiara dan Enfeeblement Ring; dijaga Sahagin. Hard: kalahkan Sahagin Prince penjaga stash = Way of the Fist Vol. XII.
objectives.whereEn: Former Disposal Area: after the Mischievous Shoat is defeated, don't go up the stairs right away; use the console on the right to drain the water, then open the dragon gate with the Vault Key. Contents: Emerald Tiara and Enfeeblement Ring; guarded by Sahagin. Hard: defeat the Sahagin Prince guarding the stash = Way of the Fist Vol. XII.

objectives.name: Music Disc: The Chase
objectives.where: Aqueduct 4: vending machine di ruang kecil di jalur cerita sewer, dekat bangku sebelum terowongan tempat Leslie menunggu, 50 gil.
objectives.whereEn: Aqueduct 4: vending machine in a small room on the sewer story path, near the bench before the tunnel where Leslie waits, 50 gil.

objectives.name: For the Reunion
objectives.where: Lemah Fire (Ifrit oke). Bunuh Shoat cepat, dodge Backwater Blast; Star Pendant bantu di Hard. Hard: + Way of the Fist Vol. IX.
objectives.whereEn: Weak to Fire (Ifrit is fine). Kill the Shoat quickly, dodge Backwater Blast; Star Pendant helps on Hard. Hard: + Way of the Fist Vol. IX.

objectives.name: Moogle Medal x3 + Grappling Gun
objectives.where: Urban Advancement District: setelah Leslie memberi Grappling Gun di gerbang, peti 3 Moogle Medal ada di jalan di belakangmu; pintu di dekatnya bisa dipakai kembali lewat sewer.
objectives.whereEn: Urban Advancement District: after Leslie gives you the Grappling Gun at the gate, the chest with 3 Moogle Medals is on the road behind you; the nearby door can be reused via the sewer.

objectives.name: Letter from the Guardian Angel (Elemental Materia)
objectives.where: Urban Advancement District: surat tergeletak di tanah di ujung distrik dekat gerbang Leslie, hanya muncul kalau semua side quest Ch1-14 di playthrough ini selesai. Isinya Elemental Materia + trofi Divine Gratitude.
objectives.whereEn: Urban Advancement District: a letter lying on the ground at the end of the district near Leslie's gate, only appears if all Ch1-14 side quests in this playthrough are completed. Contains Elemental Materia + Divine Gratitude trophy.

objectives.name: Divine Gratitude
objectives.where: Dari surat Guardian Angel. Best in the Business (26 quest) tetap butuh Chapter Select Ch9 buat 2 quest alternatif.
objectives.whereEn: From the Guardian Angel letter. Best in the Business (26 quests) still needs Chapter Select Ch9 for 2 alternate quests.

objectives.name: Over the Wall
objectives.where: Leslie konfirmasi sebelum manjat pakai Grappling Gun.
objectives.whereEn: Leslie confirms before climbing with the Grappling Gun.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: beresin 9 Odd Jobs + Johnny's Stolen Wallet, semua Colosseum challenge, disc, Moogle Emporium, Chadley/Bahamut, dan ambil Letter from the Guardian Angel. Setelah manjat, hub Sector 5/6 & Wall Market terkunci.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: finish the 9 Odd Jobs + Johnny's Stolen Wallet, all Colosseum challenges, discs, Moogle Emporium, Chadley/Bahamut, and pick up the Letter from the Guardian Angel. After climbing, the Sector 5/6 hub & Wall Market are locked.

chapters.title: The Day Midgar Stood Still
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Chapter ini linear dan semua chest cuma ada di sini. Begitu sampai atas plate (To the Top of the Plate) dan lawan The Valkyrie, area reruntuhan nggak bisa didatangi lagi.

objectives.name: A Broken City
objectives.where: Cloud, Barret, Tifa mulai di puing plate yang runtuh. Ikuti marker hijau ke arah atas.
objectives.whereEn: Cloud, Barret and Tifa start on the rubble of the collapsed plate. Follow the green marker upward.

objectives.name: The Climb
objectives.where: Naik tangga dan platform melingkar. Ada dua Byobapolis (lemah es/angin), chest Mega-Potion di platform bundar setelah tangga pertama.
objectives.whereEn: Climb the stairs and the circular platforms. There are two Byobapolis (weak to ice/wind) and a Mega-Potion chest on the round platform after the first stairs.

objectives.name: Enemy Skill: Algid Aura
objectives.where: Distillation Tower 2 - 3F: di objective The Climb (55 m) muncul sekelompok Cerulean Drake; biarkan Icy Aura mengenai karakter yang memasang Enemy Skill materia.
objectives.whereEn: Distillation Tower 2 - 3F: at The Climb objective (55 m) a group of Cerulean Drake appears; let the Icy Aura hit the character equipped with the Enemy Skill materia.

objectives.name: Hiding in Plain Sight
objectives.where: Lawan 3-C SOLDIER Operator (lemah api) dan Elite Helitrooper; chest 3.000 gil sesudahnya. Chest Hi-Potion ada di lantai dengan Shock-Ray dan Slug-Ray.
objectives.whereEn: Fight 3-C SOLDIER Operator (weak to fire) and Elite Helitrooper; a 3.000 gil chest is there afterwards. A Hi-Potion chest is on the floor with Shock-Ray and Slug-Ray.

objectives.name: The Path to Greater Heights / The Crumbling Building
objectives.where: Pakai titik grapple untuk masuk ke gedung miring. Turbo-Ether dan Smelling Salts ada di struktur besi merah sekitar sini.
objectives.whereEn: Use the grapple point to enter the tilted building. Turbo-Ether and Smelling Salts are on the red iron structure around here.

objectives.name: Lurking in the Darkness
objectives.where: Central Tower - 1F: vending machine di area istirahat di jalur utama, 50 gil. Satu-satunya disc di chapter ini.
objectives.whereEn: Central Tower - 1F: vending machine in the rest area on the main path, 50 gil. The only disc in this chapter.

objectives.name: Enchanted Ring
objectives.where: Central Tower - 8F: sekitar 110 m, grapple ke platform di dinding belakang dekat tangga, memutar lewat tangga darurat luar lalu turun; peti di dalam gedung.
objectives.whereEn: Central Tower - 8F: around 110 m, grapple to the platform on the back wall near the stairs, loop around via the outer emergency stairs and drop down; the chest is inside the building.

objectives.name: Flight of the Valkyrie / To the Stairs
objectives.where: Valkyrie mulai muncul dan mengejar. Terus ikuti marker ke tangga.
objectives.whereEn: The Valkyrie starts appearing and chases you. Keep following the marker to the stairs.

objectives.name: Magician's Bracelet
objectives.where: Collapsed Highway: sekitar 145 m, setelah Byobapolis dan Cerulean Drake kalah, grapple dari sisi kiri platform paling kanan ke scaffolding; peti di atas.
objectives.whereEn: Collapsed Highway: around 145 m, after defeating the Byobapolis and Cerulean Drake, grapple from the left side of the rightmost platform to the scaffolding; the chest is on top.

objectives.name: In Hot Pursuit
objectives.where: Kejar terus ke atas. Chest Remedy ada di balik tangga dekat vending machine sebelum objective terakhir.
objectives.whereEn: Keep chasing upward. A Remedy chest is behind the stairs near the vending machine before the last objective.

objectives.name: To the Top of the Plate
objectives.where: Boss lemah petir dan angin; hindari laser biru vertikal. Hadiah: Cog Bangle.
objectives.whereEn: The boss is weak to lightning and wind; avoid the vertical blue laser. Reward: Cog Bangle.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: pastikan sudah ambil Enchanted Ring, Magician's Bracelet, disc Lurking in the Darkness, dan Algid Aura (Cerulean Drake). Setelah ini area chapter 15 tertutup.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: make sure you have taken the Enchanted Ring, Magician's Bracelet, the Lurking in the Darkness disc, and Algid Aura (Cerulean Drake). After this, the chapter 15 area is locked.

objectives.name: Cog Bangle
objectives.where: Collapsed Highway: otomatis didapat setelah mengalahkan The Valkyrie di puncak rute.
objectives.whereEn: Collapsed Highway: obtained automatically after defeating The Valkyrie at the top of the route.

objectives.name: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. XII
objectives.where: Collapsed Highway: hanya Hard Mode, kalahkan The Valkyrie lewat Chapter Select.
objectives.whereEn: Collapsed Highway: Hard Mode only, defeat The Valkyrie via Chapter Select.

objectives.name: The Pizza in the Sky
objectives.where: Otomatis saat Chapter 15 selesai.
objectives.whereEn: Automatic when Chapter 15 is completed.

chapters.title: The Belly of the Beast
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Setelah menyusup lewat ventilasi lantai 64 (Reconnaissance) dan masuk lab Hojo, kamu nggak bisa balik ke lantai 59-63. Simulator Shinra, Chadley, Hart, jukebox dan chest bawah semuanya tertinggal (baru bisa lagi via Chapter Select).

objectives.name: Infiltration
objectives.where: Masuk lewat truk ke garasi bawah. Chest 2 Hi-Potion di jalur turun tangga, Turbo-Ether/Ether dekat vending machine.
objectives.whereEn: Enter through the truck into the lower garage. A chest with 2 Hi-Potion is on the path down the stairs; Turbo-Ether/Ether near the vending machine.

objectives.name: Bust Out of the Garage
objectives.where: Buka gerbang demi gerbang sambil lawan Elite Security Officer. Chest Molotov di ruang utara, 2 Mega-Potion di pojok timur laut.
objectives.whereEn: Open the gates one by one while fighting Elite Security Officer. A Molotov chest is in the north room, 2 Mega-Potion in the northeast corner.

objectives.name: Moogle Medal
objectives.where: Lobby: peti di samping pot tanaman di pojok barat daya lobby Shinra Building (1F); berputar lewat depan.
objectives.whereEn: Lobby: a chest next to a potted plant in the southwest corner of the Shinra Building lobby (1F); go around via the front.

objectives.name: Shinra Building Intel / Acquiring the Keycard
objectives.where: Tifa main sendiri: lompat di rangka lampu lobby lalu ambil keycard dari meja resepsionis. Ada chest 2.000 gil di koridor timur.
objectives.whereEn: Tifa plays alone: jump across the lobby light fixture frame, then take the keycard from the reception desk. There is a 2.000 gil chest in the east corridor.

objectives.name: Purple Pain
objectives.where: Light Fixtures: saat Tifa melompat di rangka lampu lobby, ambil rangka kedua dari platform (jangan naik tangga dulu); peti ungu di platform.
objectives.whereEn: Light Fixtures: when Tifa jumps on the lobby light fixture frame, take the second frame from the platform (do not climb the stairs yet); the purple chest is on the platform.

objectives.name: Iron Maiden
objectives.where: Exhibition Hall: lantai 3F, setelah punya keycard pertama buka pintu di kanan/timur pintu keycard tengah di Elevator Hall; peti di dinding utara ruang pamer.
objectives.whereEn: Exhibition Hall: 3F, after getting the first keycard, open the door to the right/east of the central keycard door in the Elevator Hall; the chest is on the north wall of the exhibition room.

objectives.name: Reach for the Skyview Hall / Use the Elevator / Use the Emergency Stairwell
objectives.where: Pilih lift atau tangga ke lantai 59. Pilihannya cuma beda dialog, item sama.
objectives.whereEn: Choose the lift or the stairs to floor 59. The choice only changes the dialogue; the items are the same.

objectives.name: Playing the Tourist
objectives.where: Ikuti pameran untuk upgrade keycard dan cari tahu soal kontak misterius.
objectives.whereEn: Follow the exhibition to upgrade the keycard and find out about the mysterious contact.

objectives.name: A Helping Hand
objectives.where: Domino di perpustakaan lantai 62 upgrade keycard kamu. Chest 3.000 gil di area lingkar utara perpustakaan.
objectives.whereEn: Domino in the floor 62 library upgrades your keycard. A 3.000 gil chest is in the north ring area of the library.

objectives.name: EKG Cannon
objectives.where: Corporate Archives - Lobby: lantai 62, bicara dengan Hart (asisten Domino) di depan kantor wali kota dan bayar 10.000 gil. Siapkan uang sebelum Chapter 16.
objectives.whereEn: Corporate Archives - Lobby: floor 62, talk to Hart (Domino's assistant) in front of the mayor's office and pay 10.000 gil. Have the money ready before Chapter 16.

objectives.name: Simulator
objectives.where: Wajib di Combat Simulator lantai 63 (tanpa item). Menang = Mega-Potion, akses lounge simulator, dan bertemu Chadley.
objectives.whereEn: Mandatory at the floor 63 Combat Simulator (no items). Winning gives a Mega-Potion, access to the simulator lounge, and a meeting with Chadley.

objectives.name: Scarlet's Theme
objectives.where: Combat Simulator Lounge: lantai 63, jukebox di sebelah kanan Combat Simulator, dekat bangku di pojok tenggara level atas. Disc terakhir di game utama.
objectives.whereEn: Combat Simulator Lounge: floor 63, the jukebox to the right of the Combat Simulator, near the bench in the southeast corner of the upper level. The last disc in the main game.

objectives.name: Chadley: Battle Intel & materia terakhir
objectives.where: Combat Simulator Lounge: Chadley ada di lantai 63 setelah challenge simulator wajib. Setor sisa Battle Intel dan beli materia yang sudah terbuka.
objectives.whereEn: Combat Simulator Lounge: Chadley is on floor 63 after the mandatory simulator challenge. Turn in the remaining Battle Intel and buy the unlocked materia.

objectives.name: Bahamut
objectives.where: Bisa sejak Ch14 di terminal Chadley (Center District) atau di Combat Simulator Lounge: VR Combat Simulation: Bahamut dari Chadley, setelah Battle Intel #1-19 beres. Kalau belum siap, bisa via Chapter Select.
objectives.whereEn: Available since Ch14 at Chadley's terminal (Center District) or in the Combat Simulator Lounge: VR Combat Simulation: Bahamut from Chadley, once Battle Intel #1-19 is done. If you are not ready, use Chapter Select.

objectives.name: Cog Bangle
objectives.where: Combat Simulator Lounge: challenge Cloud vs. SOLDIER Trainees (bintang 4).
objectives.whereEn: Combat Simulator Lounge: Cloud vs. SOLDIER Trainees challenge (4 stars).

objectives.name: Supreme Bracer
objectives.where: Combat Simulator Lounge: challenge Barret vs. SOLDIER Trainees (bintang 4).
objectives.whereEn: Combat Simulator Lounge: Barret vs. SOLDIER Trainees challenge (4 stars).

objectives.name: Rune Armlet
objectives.where: Combat Simulator Lounge: challenge Tifa vs. SOLDIER Trainees (bintang 4). Versi Aerith (Geometric Bracelet) baru bisa saat replay Chapter 17.
objectives.whereEn: Combat Simulator Lounge: Tifa vs. SOLDIER Trainees challenge (4 stars). The Aerith version (Geometric Bracelet) is only available when replaying Chapter 17.

objectives.name: Gil Up
objectives.where: Combat Simulator Lounge: challenge Two-Person Team vs. High Flyers.
objectives.whereEn: Combat Simulator Lounge: Two-Person Team vs. High Flyers challenge.

objectives.name: EXP Up
objectives.where: Combat Simulator Lounge: challenge Three-Person Team vs. Team Ragbag.
objectives.whereEn: Combat Simulator Lounge: Three-Person Team vs. Team Ragbag challenge.

objectives.name: Reconnaissance
objectives.where: Pakai keycard baru dari simulator, masuk toilet dan merangkak di duct untuk menguping rapat eksekutif.
objectives.whereEn: Use the new keycard from the simulator, enter the restroom and crawl through the duct to eavesdrop on the executive meeting.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: ambil Purple Pain, Iron Maiden, Moogle Medal, EKG Cannon (Hart 10.000 gil), Scarlet's Theme, semua tantangan simulator (Cog Bangle, Supreme Bracer, Rune Armlet, Gil Up, EXP Up), dan beres-beres Battle Intel/Bahamut di Chadley.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: get Purple Pain, Iron Maiden, Moogle Medal, EKG Cannon (Hart 10.000 gil), Scarlet's Theme, all simulator challenges (Cog Bangle, Supreme Bracer, Rune Armlet, Gil Up, EXP Up), and finish the Battle Intel/Bahamut cleanup with Chadley.

objectives.name: HP Up
objectives.where: Ventilation Duct: lantai 64 (objective Reconnaissance), saat merangkak di saluran udara ambil kiri di cabang kedua.
objectives.whereEn: Ventilation Duct: floor 64 (Reconnaissance objective), while crawling through the air duct take the left at the second branch.

objectives.name: Operation: Save Aerith
objectives.where: Lab Hojo lantai 65; chest 2 Antidote, 2 Celeris, 2 Remedy di lorong dan ruang tabung. Boss: bunuh minion H0512-OPT dulu. Hadiah: Talisman.
objectives.whereEn: Hojo's Laboratory, floor 65; chests with 2 Antidote, 2 Celeris, 2 Remedy in the corridor and the tube room. Boss: kill the H0512-OPT minions first. Reward: Talisman.

objectives.name: Talisman
objectives.where: Hojo's Laboratory (lantai 66): otomatis setelah mengalahkan Specimen H0512.
objectives.whereEn: Hojo's Laboratory (floor 66): automatic after defeating Specimen H0512.

objectives.name: The Art of Swordplay Vol. XII
objectives.where: Hojo's Laboratory (lantai 66): hanya Hard Mode, kalahkan Specimen H0512.
objectives.whereEn: Hojo's Laboratory (floor 66): Hard Mode only, defeat Specimen H0512.

objectives.name: No Appointment Needed
objectives.where: Otomatis saat Chapter 16 selesai.
objectives.whereEn: Automatic when Chapter 16 is completed.

chapters.title: Deliverance from Chaos
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Di playthrough pertama tidak ada Combat Simulator/VR Shinra di chapter ini (lokasi simulator kedua cuma muncul saat replay via Chapter Select). Setelah tim kumpul dan naik lift di Source of the Sound, cerita jalan terus sampai akhir; The Drum nggak bisa didatangi lagi.

objectives.name: Reinforced Staff
objectives.where: Specimen Enclosures: Hojo's Laboratory lantai 65, peti ungu di kamar awal Aerith.
objectives.whereEn: Specimen Enclosures: Hojo's Laboratory floor 65, purple chest in Aerith's starting room.

objectives.name: Enfeeblement Ring
objectives.where: Specimen Enclosures: setelah keluar kamar Aerith, peti di ruang sel ketiga; ruang keempat (kanan) berisi Phoenix Down, Ether di lorong sesudahnya.
objectives.whereEn: Specimen Enclosures: after leaving Aerith's room, the chest is in the third cell room; the fourth room (right) holds a Phoenix Down, and an Ether is in the corridor after it.

objectives.name: A Way Out
objectives.where: Balik lewat lab, lawan Unknown Entity. Ada bangku + vending machine sebelum lift ke The Drum.
objectives.whereEn: Go back through the lab and fight Unknown Entity. There is a bench + vending machine before the lift to The Drum.

objectives.name: Shinra Combat Simulator (Chapter Select)
objectives.where: Hojo's Laboratory lantai 66 (A Way Out): hanya saat replay. Di lorong tepat setelah pertempuran pertama, Chadley muncul; masuk ruangan berikutnya lalu belok kiri ke simulator. Ada Aerith vs. SOLDIER Trainees (Geometric Bracelet) dan challenge bintang 5+.
objectives.whereEn: Hojo's Laboratory floor 66 (A Way Out): replay only. In the corridor right after the first battle, Chadley appears; enter the next room, then turn left to the simulator. It has Aerith vs. SOLDIER Trainees (Geometric Bracelet) and 5+ star challenges.

objectives.name: 3-C SOLDIER Candidates manuscripts
objectives.where: Simulator replay Ch17: Cloud/Barret/Tifa/Aerith vs. 3-C SOLDIER Candidates memberi Art of Swordplay XIII, Sharpshooter's Companion XIII, Way of the Fist XIII, Telluric Scriptures XI.
objectives.whereEn: Ch17 replay simulator: Cloud/Barret/Tifa/Aerith vs. 3-C SOLDIER Candidates give Art of Swordplay XIII, Sharpshooter's Companion XIII, Way of the Fist XIII, Telluric Scriptures XI.

objectives.name: Refocus
objectives.where: Simulator replay Ch17: Two-Person Team vs. Dynamic Duos dan Three-Person Team vs. Monsters of Legend, masing-masing satu.
objectives.whereEn: Ch17 replay simulator: Two-Person Team vs. Dynamic Duos and Three-Person Team vs. Monsters of Legend, one each.

objectives.name: Enemy Skill: Bad Breath
objectives.where: Simulator replay Ch17: di Monsters of Legend biarkan Malboro memakai Bad Breath ke pemegang Enemy Skill materia.
objectives.whereEn: Ch17 replay simulator: in Monsters of Legend, let the Malboro use Bad Breath on the holder of the Enemy Skill materia.

objectives.name: Gotterdammerung
objectives.where: Simulator replay Ch17: Three-Person Team vs. Top Secrets (Pride and Joy Prototype). Syarat: semua Battle Intel, semua Colosseum Ch9 dan Ch14, serta challenge simulator lain beres.
objectives.whereEn: Ch17 replay simulator: Three-Person Team vs. Top Secrets (Pride and Joy Prototype). Requirements: all Battle Intel, all Colosseum Ch9 and Ch14, and the other simulator challenges done.

objectives.name: Ultimate Weapon
objectives.where: Kalahkan Pride and Joy Prototype di Top Secrets.
objectives.whereEn: Defeat the Pride and Joy Prototype in Top Secrets.

objectives.name: Find the Others
objectives.where: Party terpisah. Tarik tuas, lawan Monodrive; Red XIII ikut sebagai tamu.
objectives.whereEn: The party is separated. Pull the lever, fight Monodrive; Red XIII joins as a guest.

objectives.name: Poison
objectives.where: The Drum, di luar 1st Ward: di persimpangan setelah Monodrive pertama ambil jalur kanan menyeberangi pod. Juga dijual di toko materia.
objectives.whereEn: The Drum, outside 1st Ward: at the junction after the first Monodrive take the right path across the pods. Also sold at the materia shop.

objectives.name: Find Barret / Use the Central Terminal / 2nd Ward
objectives.where: Ikuti teriakan Barret ke atas tangga; lawan M.O.T.H. Unit. Chest 3.000 gil di ruang kecil tempat Unknown Entity lompat.
objectives.whereEn: Follow Barret's shouts up the stairs; fight M.O.T.H. Unit. A 3.000 gil chest is in the small room where Unknown Entity jumps.

objectives.name: Twin Stinger
objectives.where: Passage C: The Drum level 3, setelah ruang tiga gelombang musuh, peti ungu di kiri tangga (bawah tangga kiri) di 1st Ward.
objectives.whereEn: Passage C: The Drum level 3, after the room with three waves of enemies, the purple chest is to the left of the stairs (under the left stairs) in 1st Ward.

objectives.name: Research the 3rd Ward / To the Central Terminal / A Way Up
objectives.where: Ganti grup lewat terminal. Tarik tuas buka dinding pod; Ether di seberang pod.
objectives.whereEn: Switch groups via the terminal. Pull the lever to open the pod wall; an Ether is across the pod.

objectives.name: Time
objectives.where: Central Control Terminal: tergeletak di sisi kiri platform tengah, dekat konsol/tuas.
objectives.whereEn: Central Control Terminal: lying on the left side of the central platform, near the console/lever.

objectives.name: Force Bracelet
objectives.where: 3rd Ward - Piping System: Tifa & Aerith, setelah pipa runtuh tarik tuas di pintu rana; peti di balik gerbang. Swordipede juga memberi Force Bracelet.
objectives.whereEn: 3rd Ward - Piping System: Tifa & Aerith, after the pipe collapses pull the lever at the shutter door; the chest is behind the gate. Swordipede also gives Force Bracelet.

objectives.name: Astral Cuff
objectives.where: 2nd Ward - Biological Testing: Cloud & Barret, ruang di kanan setelah kaca antipeluru, memutar ke kanan di balik tumpukan kotak. Jenova Dreamweaver juga memberi Astral Cuff.
objectives.whereEn: 2nd Ward - Biological Testing: Cloud & Barret, the room on the right after the bulletproof glass, loop right behind the stack of crates. Jenova Dreamweaver also gives Astral Cuff.

objectives.name: Chain Bangle
objectives.where: 2nd Ward - Control Deck: peti di pojok kanan ruang tabung uji hijau, sebelum tangga.
objectives.whereEn: 2nd Ward - Control Deck: chest in the right corner of the green test tube room, before the stairs.

objectives.name: Rescuing Red XIII
objectives.where: Kerjasama dua grup; lawan Sledgeworm, Enhanced Shock Trooper, dan Brain Pod.
objectives.whereEn: Two groups cooperate; fight Sledgeworm, Enhanced Shock Trooper, and Brain Pod.

objectives.name: 4th Ward
objectives.where: Di pipa belok kiri dulu untuk 2 Mega-Potion. Boss Swordipede (pindah ke Tifa/Aerith di tengah fight); hadiah Force Bracelet.
objectives.whereEn: In the pipe, turn left first for 2 Mega-Potion. Boss Swordipede (switch to Tifa/Aerith mid-fight); reward: Force Bracelet.

objectives.name: Telluric Scriptures Vol. XII
objectives.where: 4th Ward - Synthesis Chamber: hanya Hard Mode, kalahkan Swordipede.
objectives.whereEn: 4th Ward - Synthesis Chamber: Hard Mode only, defeat Swordipede.

objectives.name: Source of the Sound
objectives.where: Semua bertemu lagi; bangku dan vending machine tersedia. Red XIII bilang ini titik akhir.
objectives.whereEn: Everyone meets up again; a bench and vending machine are available. Red XIII says this is the end point.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: cek sudah punya Reinforced Staff, Twin Stinger, Poison, Time, Enfeeblement Ring, Force Bracelet, Astral Cuff, Chain Bangle. Setelah naik lift, The Drum terkunci dan cerita lanjut ke boss beruntun.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: check that you have Reinforced Staff, Twin Stinger, Poison, Time, Enfeeblement Ring, Force Bracelet, Astral Cuff, Chain Bangle. After taking the lift, The Drum is locked and the story continues into back-to-back bosses.

objectives.name: The Ominous Trail
objectives.where: Di atap lantai eksekutif; Jenova sering counter serangan melee. Hadiah Astral Cuff.
objectives.whereEn: On the roof of the executive floor; Jenova often counters melee attacks. Reward: Astral Cuff.

objectives.name: Way of the Fist Vol. XIV
objectives.where: Lantai eksekutif Shinra Building: hanya Hard Mode, kalahkan Jenova Dreamweaver.
objectives.whereEn: Shinra Building executive floor: Hard Mode only, defeat Jenova Dreamweaver.

objectives.name: The Showdown
objectives.where: Cloud solo. Serang Rufus saat dia reload. Ada bangku sebelum fight.
objectives.whereEn: Cloud solo. Attack Rufus while he reloads. There is a bench before the fight.

objectives.name: The Art of Swordplay Vol. XIV
objectives.where: Heliport: hanya Hard Mode, kalahkan Rufus.
objectives.whereEn: Heliport: Hard Mode only, defeat Rufus.

objectives.name: The Great Escape
objectives.where: Barret + Aerith. Tahan Square saat cutscene lift untuk ganti equipment (misal pindah aksesori dari Cloud).
objectives.whereEn: Barret + Aerith. Hold Square during the lift cutscene to change equipment (e.g. move accessories over from Cloud).

objectives.name: Telluric Scriptures Vol. XIII
objectives.where: Shinra Building (The Great Escape): hanya Hard Mode, kalahkan The Arsenal.
objectives.whereEn: Shinra Building (The Great Escape): Hard Mode only, defeat The Arsenal.

objectives.name: Emerging from Chaos
objectives.where: Otomatis saat Chapter 17 selesai.
objectives.whereEn: Automatic when Chapter 17 is completed.

chapters.title: Destiny's Crossroads
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Chapter terakhir. Setelah lewat gerbang tol di jalan tol Midgar, kamu langsung masuk boss beruntun Whisper Harbinger lalu Sephiroth tanpa bisa balik. Sisa konten (simulator, Colosseum, Hard Mode) dikerjakan via Chapter Select setelah tamat.

objectives.name: Flying Through the Night
objectives.where: Cloud naik motor melindungi truk di jalan tol. Boss Motor Ball: hancurkan roda dari samping, pukul badan saat stagger.
objectives.whereEn: Cloud rides a motorcycle to protect the truck on the highway. Boss Motor Ball: destroy the wheels from the side, hit the body during stagger.

objectives.name: Prepare at the Bench (Toll Gate)
objectives.where: Isi ulang di bangku + vending machine. Pasang Elemental + Ice di armor untuk menahan sihir Sephiroth, bawa Phoenix Down dan Elixir.
objectives.whereEn: Restock at the bench + vending machine. Equip Elemental + Ice on your armor to resist Sephiroth's magic, and bring Phoenix Down and Elixir.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: ini titik akhir permanen. Isi item, atur materia, dan simpan. Setelah gerbang tol langsung boss beruntun tanpa save point.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: this is the permanent point of no return. Stock up on items, set your materia, and save. After the toll gate, back-to-back bosses follow with no save point.

objectives.name: The Turning Point
objectives.where: Tiga fase Whisper kecil per kelompok lalu Whisper Harbinger gabungan. Panjang, jadi atur MP.
objectives.whereEn: Three phases of small Whisper per group, then the combined Whisper Harbinger. It is long, so manage your MP.

objectives.name: Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. XIV
objectives.where: End of the Road: hanya Hard Mode, kalahkan Whisper Harbinger.
objectives.whereEn: End of the Road: Hard Mode only, defeat Whisper Harbinger.

objectives.name: Final Boss
objectives.where: Cloud solo dulu, lalu dua anggota party bergabung. Waspadai Octaslash, Shadow Flare dan Heartless Angel. Hard: + Telluric Scriptures Vol. XIV.
objectives.whereEn: Cloud solo first, then two party members join. Watch out for Octaslash, Shadow Flare and Heartless Angel. Hard: + Telluric Scriptures Vol. XIV.

objectives.name: Destiny's Crossroads
objectives.where: Otomatis saat Chapter 18 selesai (tamat).
objectives.whereEn: Automatic when Chapter 18 is completed (end of the game).

objectives.name: Post-game: Chapter Select & Hard Mode
objectives.where: Setelah tamat: Chapter Select dan Hard Mode terbuka; dipakai untuk item missable, manuskrip Hard Mode, simulator Ch17 dan trofi Hardened Veteran.
objectives.whereEn: After the ending: Chapter Select and Hard Mode unlock; used for missable items, Hard Mode manuscripts, the Ch17 simulator and the Hardened Veteran trophy.

chapters.title: INTERmission 1: Wutai's Finest
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Begitu objective Change of Plans (ikut Nayo ke arah stasiun kereta), Yuffie nggak bisa balik ke Sektor 7 Slums. Fort Condor, Happy Turtle flyers, Ramuh dan semua chest di slums harus beres sebelumnya.

objectives.name: First Challenge / Power...Down?
objectives.where: Yuffie dan Sonon mulai di Sector 7 Outskirts; tutorial lempar shuriken dan Synergy.
objectives.whereEn: Yuffie and Sonon start in the Sector 7 Outskirts; shuriken throwing and Synergy tutorial.

objectives.name: Mark of the Moogle
objectives.where: Lempar shuriken ke tanda Moogle untuk menyalakan lift.
objectives.whereEn: Throw a shuriken at the Moogle mark to power the lift.

objectives.name: HP Up
objectives.where: Abandoned Warehouse - 2F: naik lift pertama (lempar senjata ke tombol lift), seberangi lantai atas lalu naik lift kedua; materia ada di ujung atas. Ambil sebelum keluar gudang.
objectives.whereEn: Abandoned Warehouse - 2F: take the first lift (throw a weapon at the lift button), cross the upper floor and take the second lift; the materia is at the top end. Grab it before leaving the warehouse.

objectives.name: Power Wristguards
objectives.where: Scrapyard: begitu keluar dari gudang pertama, chest di sebelah kanan dekat tong/kontainer kuning setelah turunan kayu.
objectives.whereEn: Scrapyard: right after leaving the first warehouse, the chest is on the right near the yellow barrels/container, after the wooden slope down.

objectives.name: Wind
objectives.where: Connecting Passageway: setelah puing jatuh dan musuh beres, putari celah besar searah jarum jam lalu panjat tangga menara di kanan (sebelum gerbang poster Moogle). Materia di puncak.
objectives.whereEn: Connecting Passageway: after the debris falls and the enemies are cleared, circle the big gap clockwise and climb the tower ladder on the right (before the Moogle poster gate). The materia is at the top.

objectives.name: Don't Fear, Yuffie's Here
objectives.where: Seberangi celah pakai crane, lawan Wayward Wolf. Chest 1.000 gil di jalan buntu terowongan.
objectives.whereEn: Cross the gap using the crane and fight the Wayward Wolf. A chest with 1,000 gil is at the tunnel dead end.

objectives.name: MP Up
objectives.where: Scrap Boulevard: masuk terowongan/gua kecil di kiri poster Moogle dekat gerbang terkunci, susuri dinding kiri; materia di lantai gua.
objectives.whereEn: Scrap Boulevard: enter the small tunnel/cave left of the Moogle poster near the locked gate and follow the left wall; the materia is on the cave floor.

objectives.name: Esteemed Avalanche Colleagues
objectives.where: Temui Zhijie dan tim Avalanche di markas Sektor 7.
objectives.whereEn: Meet Zhijie and the Avalanche team at the Sector 7 base.

objectives.name: Boomerang
objectives.where: Base Interior (markas Avalanche): turun tangga ke lantai bawah lalu belok kiri; chest ungu.
objectives.whereEn: Base Interior (Avalanche base): go down the stairs to the lower floor and turn left; purple chest.

objectives.name: Gain Intel / Billy Bob / Polk / Nayo
objectives.where: Bicara dua kali dengan masing-masing di markas.
objectives.whereEn: Talk to each person at the base twice.

objectives.name: Mastering Fort Condor
objectives.where: Base Interior: bicara dengan Polk di markas Avalanche; tutorial Fort Condor wajib sebelum boleh keluar. Menang lawan Polk memberi Sorcerer Board I dan Helitrooper (Vanguard), lalu lawan lain muncul di slums. Hadiah mengalahkan Polk: Sorcerer Board I dan Helitrooper (Vanguard).
objectives.whereEn: Base Interior: talk to Polk at the Avalanche base; the Fort Condor tutorial is mandatory before you can leave. Beating Polk gives Sorcerer Board I and Helitrooper (Vanguard), then other opponents appear in the slums. Reward for beating Polk: Sorcerer Board I and Helitrooper (Vanguard).

objectives.name: Scout Out Sector 7 / Combat Simulator / The Happy Envoy
objectives.where: Jelajahi slums. Ini waktu terbaik untuk semua konten sampingan.
objectives.whereEn: Explore the slums. This is the best time for all side content.

objectives.name: Chadley's Research
objectives.where: Residential Area: Chadley duduk di tempat biasanya, sisi barat/barat daya slums (barat markas Avalanche). Pilih VR mission Ramuh di Shinra Combat Simulator.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: Chadley sits in his usual spot, on the west/southwest side of the slums (west of the Avalanche base). Choose the Ramuh VR mission in the Shinra Combat Simulator.

objectives.name: Ramuh
objectives.where: Residential Area: hadiah mengalahkan Ramuh di simulator Chadley (sisi barat daya slums). Pasang Wind sebelum masuk.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: reward for beating Ramuh in Chadley's simulator (southwest side of the slums). Equip Wind before entering.

objectives.name: The Happy Turtle Ad Campaign
objectives.where: Residential Area: Old Snapper (kostum kura-kura, papan kayu) di bagian selatan slums, tenggara markas Avalanche. Kumpulkan 6 flyer; petunjuk ada di daftar Discovery dan musik jingle terdengar di dekat flyer.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: Old Snapper (turtle costume, wooden board) in the southern part of the slums, southeast of the Avalanche base. Collect 6 flyers; hints are in the Discovery list and jingle music plays near a flyer.

objectives.name: Happy Turtle Flyer: Kids' Fort
objectives.where: Residential Area: tepat di selatan Old Snapper, area kotak tempat anak-anak main; jalan menembus tumpukan kardus/peti di belakang, flyer di baliknya.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: just south of Old Snapper, the boxed area where the children play; walk through the pile of cardboard/crates at the back, the flyer is behind it.

objectives.name: Happy Turtle Flyer: Balloon
objectives.where: Residential Area: ujung paling selatan slums (gang tempat anak-anak menonton balon). Lompati peti ke petak timur, lempar shuriken ke balon kura-kura, lalu pungut flyer yang jatuh di area utama.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: the far southern end of the slums (alley where the children watch the balloon). Jump over the crates to the east plot, throw a shuriken at the turtle balloon, then pick up the flyer that falls in the main area.

objectives.name: Happy Turtle Flyer: Apartment
objectives.where: Residential Area: gedung apartemen tempat Cloud tinggal (sisi barat). Bergerak hanya saat anjing tidur, sembunyi di balik peti saat ia bangun; flyer di dinding dekat pintu terakhir lantai atas.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: the apartment building where Cloud lives (west side). Move only while the dog sleeps and hide behind crates when it wakes; the flyer is on the wall near the last door on the upper floor.

objectives.name: Happy Turtle Flyer: Cat
objectives.where: Residential Area: area terbuka mirip arena di barat laut/utara slums, kiri bar Seventh Heaven dekat toko; merangkak masuk, kucing pembawa flyer bersembunyi di balik tong di bagian belakang.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: the arena-like open area in the northwest/north of the slums, left of the Seventh Heaven bar near the shop; crawl in, the cat carrying the flyer hides behind barrels at the back.

objectives.name: Happy Turtle Flyer: Bulletin Board
objectives.where: Pillar Plaza: papan pengumuman di sisi timur (jalan ke stasiun, depan pabrik Talagger); flyer menyembul di bawah poster besar Shinra.
objectives.whereEn: Pillar Plaza: notice board on the east side (road to the station, in front of the Talagger factory); the flyer sticks out from under the big Shinra poster.

objectives.name: Happy Turtle Flyer: Talagger Factory
objectives.where: Abandoned Talagger Factory: ikuti musik ke ujung timur, lewat pintu dan grate, kalahkan dua musuh kuat, lalu hancurkan kotak di bagian atas ruangan.
objectives.whereEn: Abandoned Talagger Factory: follow the music to the east end, go through the door and grate, defeat two strong enemies, then smash the box in the upper part of the room.

objectives.name: Magnify
objectives.where: Residential Area: serahkan 6 flyer ke Old Snapper di selatan slums untuk Magnify.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: hand in the 6 flyers to Old Snapper in the south of the slums for Magnify.

objectives.name: Turtle-tastic
objectives.where: Kumpulkan semua Happy Turtle flyer.
objectives.whereEn: Collect all Happy Turtle flyers.

objectives.name: Warding
objectives.where: Residential Area: barat laut markas Avalanche; masuk terowongan rongsokan di pojok barat laut ke area kelas terbuka anak-anak, materia di bawah tangga besi di belakang.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: northwest of the Avalanche base; enter the scrap tunnel in the northwest corner to the children's open classroom area, the materia is under the iron stairs at the back.

objectives.name: Chakra
objectives.where: Residential Area: atap motel, panjat dari belakang anjing yang tidur (harus sudah bicara dengan Old Snapper dulu). Chakra kedua: Abandoned Talagger Factory, pojok barat daya, dalam kotak yang bisa dihancurkan.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: motel roof, climb up from behind the sleeping dog (you must have talked to Old Snapper first). Second Chakra: Abandoned Talagger Factory, southwest corner, inside a destructible box.

objectives.name: Fort Condor: Riot Trooper Barracks
objectives.where: Residential Area: pojok tenggara, chest/pod dekat poster kura-kura (dekat tempat Wedge dan flyer balon).
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: southeast corner, chest/pod near the turtle poster (near where Wedge and the balloon flyer are).

objectives.name: First Strike
objectives.where: Abandoned Talagger Factory: masuk lewat area berpagar dari Pillar Plaza; ruang timur laut, kalahkan dua musuh mirip kalajengking, materia di pojok di balik kotak.
objectives.whereEn: Abandoned Talagger Factory: enter through the fenced area from Pillar Plaza; northeast room, defeat two scorpion-like enemies, the materia is in the corner behind a box.

objectives.name: Fort Condor: Monodrive
objectives.where: Abandoned Talagger Factory: ruang paling utara (barat laut); hancurkan peti kayu, chest kuning di baliknya.
objectives.whereEn: Abandoned Talagger Factory: the northernmost (northwest) room; smash the wooden crate, yellow chest behind it.

objectives.name: Chakra (2)
objectives.where: Abandoned Talagger Factory: pojok barat daya pabrik, di dalam kotak yang bisa dihancurkan.
objectives.whereEn: Abandoned Talagger Factory: southwest corner of the factory, inside a destructible box.

objectives.name: Fort Condor: kalahkan semua lawan
objectives.where: Residential Area (kebanyakan): Shinra Middle Manager (tengah-timur), Johnny (tengah-barat), Kyrie (barat laut dekat Stargazer Heights), Jessie (depan Seventh Heaven), Wedge (selatan), Chadley (barat markas). Roche di Pillar Plaza.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area (mostly): Shinra Middle Manager (center-east), Johnny (center-west), Kyrie (northwest near Stargazer Heights), Jessie (in front of Seventh Heaven), Wedge (south), Chadley (west of the base). Roche is in Pillar Plaza.

objectives.name: AP Up
objectives.where: Residential Area: hadiah mengalahkan Grandmaster Chadley di Fort Condor (posisi biasanya, barat markas Avalanche), plus 10.000 gil.
objectives.whereEn: Residential Area: reward for beating Grandmaster Chadley at Fort Condor (usual spot, west of the Avalanche base), plus 10,000 gil.

objectives.name: Game, Set, Master
objectives.where: Jadi grandmaster Fort Condor. Versi Hard (Condor Queen) via replay.
objectives.whereEn: Become Fort Condor grandmaster. Hard version (Condor Queen) via replay.

objectives.name: The Handoff
objectives.where: Ikuti Nayo dan lawan anak buah Don Corneo di Municipal Storage Area. Satu guide menyebut hadiah Chthonian Armlet di sini (belum pasti).
objectives.whereEn: Follow Nayo and fight Don Corneo's men in the Municipal Storage Area. One guide mentions a Chthonian Armlet reward here (unconfirmed).

objectives.name: Kindred Cord
objectives.where: Municipal Storage Area: setelah dirampok anak buah Corneo, ujung jalur baru melewati gedung tempat ID dibuat; hancurkan dinding, chest ada di depannya.
objectives.whereEn: Municipal Storage Area: after being robbed by Corneo's men, the end of the new path passes the building where IDs are made; destroy the wall, the chest is in front of it.

objectives.name: Back to Base
objectives.where: Kembali ke markas Avalanche.
objectives.whereEn: Return to the Avalanche base.

objectives.name: Change of Plans
objectives.where: Zhijie kabur dari penjaga; ikuti Nayo ke arah stasiun dan pilar.
objectives.whereEn: Zhijie escapes from the guards; follow Nayo toward the station and the pillar.

objectives.name: After Him
objectives.where: Lewati Shipping Facility menuju pilar.
objectives.whereEn: Pass through the Shipping Facility toward the pillar.

objectives.name: Indurate Staff
objectives.where: Shipping Facility Connecting Passage: lewat gerbang pagar terbuka dekat stasiun, chest ungu di area terbuka di jalur cerita (After Him).
objectives.whereEn: Shipping Facility Connecting Passage: go through the open fence gate near the station, purple chest in the open area on the story path (After Him).

objectives.name: Tracking Zhijie / Conveyor Belt Bedlam
objectives.where: Matikan conveyor dengan lempar shuriken ke saklar.
objectives.whereEn: Stop the conveyor by throwing a shuriken at the switch.

objectives.name: Gozu Drive
objectives.where: Bagian Double Back setelah adegan jatuh: drop otomatis dari Horned Cripshay pertama di area terbuka.
objectives.whereEn: Double Back section after the fall scene: automatic drop from the first Horned Cripshay in the open area.

objectives.name: Fort Condor: Sweeper
objectives.where: Ward 3: setelah tiga Cripshay, turun tangga kanan; chest di pojok (antara tiang luncur pertama dan kedua).
objectives.whereEn: Ward 3: after the three Cripshays, go down the right stairs; chest in the corner (between the first and second slide poles).

objectives.name: Prayer
objectives.where: Ward 3: turun tangga ke area bawah conveyor, kalahkan dua Lesser Drake; materia di pojok belakang dekat tempat lempar senjata untuk menghentikan conveyor.
objectives.whereEn: Ward 3: go down the stairs to the area below the conveyor, defeat two Lesser Drakes; the materia is in the back corner near the throwing spot that stops the conveyor.

objectives.name: Steel Reaper
objectives.where: Ward 1: chest ungu di kiri dinding panjat kuning, di tepi scaffolding sebelum wall-run pertama (Double Back).
objectives.whereEn: Ward 1: purple chest left of the yellow climbing wall, on the scaffolding edge before the first wall-run (Double Back).

objectives.name: Double Back
objectives.where: Setelah jatuh, kembali naik lewat wall-run. Elite Horned Cripshay (lemah es) di area terbuka; Wrath Hound di tangga kanan.
objectives.whereEn: After the fall, climb back up via wall-run. Elite Horned Cripshay (weak to ice) in the open area; Wrath Hound on the right stairs.

objectives.name: Elemental
objectives.where: Ward 1: platform tengah, dicapai lewat saklar dan dinding panjat yang berputar (puzzle wall-run).
objectives.whereEn: Ward 1: middle platform, reached via the switch and the rotating climbing wall (wall-run puzzle).

objectives.name: Fort Condor: Assassin Board III
objectives.where: Ward 2: setelah grup Toxirat, naik tangga kiri; chest/pod kuning terlihat jelas.
objectives.whereEn: Ward 2: after the Toxirat group, go up the left stairs; the yellow chest/pod is clearly visible.

objectives.name: Main Pillar Maintenance
objectives.where: Masuk area perawatan pilar.
objectives.whereEn: Enter the pillar maintenance area.

objectives.name: Magic Up
objectives.where: Perimeter Wall: di ujung barisan kontainer/conveyor yang berhenti, lompat ke kiri; materia di pojok sebelum wall-run.
objectives.whereEn: Perimeter Wall: at the end of the row of stopped containers/conveyor, jump to the left; the materia is in the corner before the wall-run.

objectives.name: Mezu Drive
objectives.where: Temporary Storage Area: drop otomatis dari Levrikon pertama (fight wajib), dekat Waste Disposal Plant.
objectives.whereEn: Temporary Storage Area: automatic drop from the first Levrikon (mandatory fight), near the Waste Disposal Plant.

objectives.name: Lightning
objectives.where: Central Maintenance Facility: ujung jalan setapak di ruang besar dalam gedung, dekat bangku dan vending machine, sebelum turun ke boss.
objectives.whereEn: Central Maintenance Facility: end of the walkway in the large room inside the building, near the bench and vending machine, before going down to the boss.

objectives.name: Save Zhijie
objectives.where: Ekor lemah petir, kepala aman diserang saat Pressured. Hancurkan Containment Drone.
objectives.whereEn: The tail is weak to lightning; the head is safe to attack while Pressured. Destroy the Containment Drone.

objectives.name: Yuffie/Sonon Manuscripts Vol. I-X
objectives.where: Hanya Hard Mode (setelah tamat sekali): Vol. I-VII dari lawan Fort Condor versi Hard (Rank 5) di Sector 7 Slums, VIII dari Horned Cripshay, IX dari Levrikon, X dari Gigantipede.
objectives.whereEn: Hard Mode only (after one playthrough): Vol. I-VII from the Hard Fort Condor opponents (Rank 5) in the Sector 7 Slums, VIII from Horned Cripshay, IX from Levrikon, X from Gigantipede.

objectives.name: Shinra Building or Bust
objectives.where: Dapat ID karyawan Shinra; chapter selesai.
objectives.whereEn: Get the Shinra employee ID; chapter complete.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: beresin Fort Condor, Chadley/Ramuh, Happy Turtle flyer & toko di slum. Setelah bicara dengan petugas kereta di stasiun, chapter selesai.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: finish Fort Condor, Chadley/Ramuh, the Happy Turtle flyers and the slum shops. After you talk to the train attendant at the station, the chapter ends.

objectives.name: Takes Two IDs to Tango
objectives.where: Selesaikan Chapter 1 INTERmission (satu sumber mengaitkannya ke Chapter 2).
objectives.whereEn: Complete Chapter 1 INTERmission (one source ties it to Chapter 2).

chapters.title: INTERmission 2: Covert Ops
chapters.pointOfNoReturn: Chapter linear di bawah tanah Shinra HQ. Setelah The Invitation (gelombang musuh di Testing Ground B20) kamu nggak bisa balik ke lantai B14-B16, jadi Box Buster dan chest harus beres dulu.

objectives.name: Scarlet's Trap / A Way Out
objectives.where: Mulai di B16 Advanced Weaponry Inspection; Scarlet kirim Slug-Ray, Cutter, Monodrive, Shock-Ray.
objectives.whereEn: Start at B16 Advanced Weaponry Inspection; Scarlet sends Slug-Ray, Cutter, Monodrive, Shock-Ray.

objectives.name: Combat Simulator INTERmission (replay)
objectives.where: Pasca-tamat lewat Chapter Select: terminal Shinra Combat Simulator muncul di awal Chapter 2; berisi tantangan bintang 3, 4 dan 7 untuk Yuffie dan Sonon.
objectives.whereEn: Post-game via Chapter Select: a Shinra Combat Simulator terminal appears at the start of Chapter 2; it contains 3-, 4- and 7-star challenges for Yuffie and Sonon.

objectives.name: Gotterdammerung (Pride and Joy Mk 0.5)
objectives.where: Simulator di awal Chapter 2 (pasca-tamat): selesaikan tantangan bintang 3 dan 4 (Bahamut, Ifrit, Ramuh), lalu tantangan bintang 7 vs. Pride and Joy Mk 0.5. Hadiah 2 Gotterdammerung.
objectives.whereEn: Simulator at the start of Chapter 2 (post-game): complete the 3- and 4-star challenges (Bahamut, Ifrit, Ramuh), then the 7-star challenge vs. Pride and Joy Mk 0.5. Reward: 2 Gotterdammerung.

objectives.name: Gotterdammerung (Weiss)
objectives.where: Bukan di INTERmission: tantangan bintang 7 'Three-person Team vs. The Immaculate' di simulator Chadley game utama (Chapter 17) setelah INTERmission tamat. Hadiah 2 Gotterdammerung.
objectives.whereEn: Not in INTERmission: the 7-star challenge 'Three-person Team vs. The Immaculate' in Chadley's simulator in the main game (Chapter 17) after INTERmission is complete. Reward: 2 Gotterdammerung.

objectives.name: Find That Materia
objectives.where: Nyalakan lagi listrik di Compressor Facilities; tiga kontainer materia terbuka.
objectives.whereEn: Turn the power back on in the Compressor Facilities; three materia containers open.

objectives.name: Ninja Cannonball
objectives.where: Compressor Facilities (B15): setelah listrik nyala lewat panel tengah, balik badan; materia di tabung tepat di seberang terminal.
objectives.whereEn: Compressor Facilities (B15): after the power comes on via the central panel, turn around; the materia is in the tube directly across from the terminal.

objectives.name: Steadfast Block
objectives.where: Compressor Facilities (B15): di salah satu mesin samping, sisi kanan lift terkunci (jalan ke barat di walkway).
objectives.whereEn: Compressor Facilities (B15): in one of the side machines, right of the locked lift (the way west on the walkway).

objectives.name: Skill Master
objectives.where: Compressor Facilities (B15): kapsul di sisi berlawanan dari Steadfast Block (ikuti walkway ke timur).
objectives.whereEn: Compressor Facilities (B15): capsule on the opposite side from Steadfast Block (follow the walkway east).

objectives.name: The Scent of Materia / Secret Vault
objectives.where: Jelajahi area perawatan; ada jalan ke Secret Vault.
objectives.whereEn: Explore the maintenance area; there is a path to the Secret Vault.

objectives.name: Ribbon
objectives.where: Central Terminal Utility Access (B14): lompat ke pipa dekat konsol, ambil pipa kiri dan panjat dinding generator ke balkon ujung timur/tenggara; chest di sana.
objectives.whereEn: Central Terminal Utility Access (B14): jump to the pipe near the console, take the left pipe and climb the generator wall to the east/southeast end balcony; chest there.

objectives.name: Volant Armlet
objectives.where: Maintenance Facilities (B14): di ruang setelah pipa, naik tangga pendek lalu ambil jalan kecil ke kiri (cabang selatan); chest.
objectives.whereEn: Maintenance Facilities (B14): in the room after the pipe, climb the short stairs then take the small path to the left (south branch); chest.

objectives.name: Djinn Staff
objectives.where: Maintenance Facilities (B14): setelah Armored Magitrooper pertama, lorong berikutnya lewat pintu kiri; chest ungu.
objectives.whereEn: Maintenance Facilities (B14): after the first Armored Magitrooper, take the left door in the next corridor; purple chest.

objectives.name: Shinra Box Buster
objectives.where: Training Room B14: setelah Power Grid level 2 nyala, pintu di belakang terbuka (Discovery Secret Vault); pakai Training Console.
objectives.whereEn: Training Room B14: after Power Grid level 2 is on, the door at the back opens (Discovery Secret Vault); use the Training Console.

objectives.name: ATB Assist
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, capai 5.000 poin.
objectives.whereEn: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, reach 5,000 points.

objectives.name: ATB Boost
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, capai 10.000 poin.
objectives.whereEn: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, reach 10,000 points.

objectives.name: ATB Stagger
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, capai 20.000 poin (membuka SOLDIER Training).
objectives.whereEn: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): Basic Training, reach 20,000 points (unlocks SOLDIER Training).

objectives.name: Box Buster: SOLDIER Training
objectives.where: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): terbuka setelah 20.000 poin di Basic Training; 10.000 poin Magnify, 30.000 Gil Up, 50.000 EXP Up.
objectives.whereEn: Training Room B14 (Shinra Box Buster): unlocked after 20,000 points in Basic Training; 10,000 points Magnify, 30,000 Gil Up, 50,000 EXP Up.

objectives.name: Materia Maven
objectives.where: Dapat semua materia Box Buster (Basic + SOLDIER Training, difficulty apa pun).
objectives.whereEn: Get all Box Buster materia (Basic + SOLDIER Training, any difficulty).

objectives.name: The Hunt Continues
objectives.where: Terus ke arah kantor Scarlet.
objectives.whereEn: Keep heading toward Scarlet's office.

objectives.name: Time
objectives.where: Central Terminal Utility Access: dari konsol cerita, panjat pipa kiri, panjat dinding, belok kiri lalu ayun lewat dua kait gantung ke platform; materia di lantai.
objectives.whereEn: Central Terminal Utility Access: from the story console, climb the left pipe, climb the wall, turn left then swing across two hanging hooks to the platform; the materia is on the floor.

objectives.name: Healing Carcanet
objectives.where: Central Terminal Utility Access (B13): setelah menembak palang besi jadi jembatan, naik pipa ke kiri sebelum menyeberang girder kedua; chest kuning di platform ujung.
objectives.whereEn: Central Terminal Utility Access (B13): after shooting the iron bar to make a bridge, climb the pipe on the left before crossing the second girder; yellow chest on the end platform.

objectives.name: AP Up
objectives.where: Materia Research Facility (B13): setelah dua musuh Magitek lapis baja dan hologram Scarlet, periksa tabung tempat Yuffie terbanting sebelum keluar ruangan.
objectives.whereEn: Materia Research Facility (B13): after the two armored Magitek enemies and the Scarlet hologram, check the tube where Yuffie was slammed before leaving the room.

objectives.name: The Invitation
objectives.where: Turun ke B20 Testing Ground dan bertahan dari beberapa gelombang.
objectives.whereEn: Go down to the B20 Testing Ground and survive several waves.
objectives.warning: SEBELUM LANJUT: ambil Ribbon, Volant Armlet, Djinn Staff, AP Up, Time, Healing Carcanet & beresin Box Buster. Setelah naik lift platform di awal The Invitation, B14, B13 & Secret Vault tertutup.
objectives.warningEn: BEFORE CONTINUING: get Ribbon, Volant Armlet, Djinn Staff, AP Up, Time, Healing Carcanet and finish Box Buster. After you ride the platform lift at the start of The Invitation, B14, B13 and the Secret Vault are closed.

objectives.name: Iron Maiden
objectives.where: Testing Ground - 4th Station (B20, The Invitation): curi dari M.O.T.H. Unit (peluang kecil). Lebih mudah: beli di vending machine.
objectives.whereEn: Testing Ground - 4th Station (B20, The Invitation): steal from the M.O.T.H. Unit (low chance). Easier: buy it from the vending machine.

objectives.name: A Fateful Confrontation
objectives.where: Jaga jarak saat dia pakai claymore; ganti strategi saat senjata berubah.
objectives.whereEn: Keep your distance when she uses the claymore; change strategy when the weapon changes.

objectives.name: Firebird Armlet
objectives.where: Heavy Weapons Platform Testing: hadiah otomatis setelah mengalahkan Scarlet dan Crimson Mare (A Fateful Confrontation).
objectives.whereEn: Heavy Weapons Platform Testing: automatic reward after defeating Scarlet and Crimson Mare (A Fateful Confrontation).

objectives.name: A New Threat / Escape
objectives.where: Lawan prajurit Deepground dan Projector, lalu kabur lewat Combat Simulator prototipe (4 gelombang).
objectives.whereEn: Fight the Deepground soldiers and the Projector, then escape through the prototype Combat Simulator (4 waves).

objectives.name: Dread / The Journey Continues
objectives.where: Boss terakhir, 4 fase. Isi bar di bangku sebelum masuk.
objectives.whereEn: Final boss, 4 phases. Fill the bar at the bench before entering.

objectives.name: Yuffie/Sonon Manuscripts Vol. XI-XIV
objectives.where: Hanya Hard Mode: XI dari Deathwheel, XII dari Scarlet & Crimson Mare, XIII dari Projector, XIV dari Nero the Sable.
objectives.whereEn: Hard Mode only: XI from Deathwheel, XII from Scarlet & Crimson Mare, XIII from Projector, XIV from Nero the Sable.

objectives.name: Out of Darkness's Clutches
objectives.where: Selesaikan Chapter 2 INTERmission. Trofi Hard kedua chapter: The Road to Revenge.
objectives.whereEn: Complete Chapter 2 INTERmission. Second chapter Hard trophy: The Road to Revenge.
